Booking.text: Booking a massage in Addis? Twelve DMs, one payment screenshot, and zero confirmation.
Meet Well Circle, your wellness tribe inside Telegram.
Pick a top studio, choose a service, pick a time, and send the request.
Booked in three taps, and you pay at the studio.

Community.text: Running alone? You skip, nobody notices, and you quit.
On Well Circle you find your crew, like the Bertusew running club.
Join the circle and save your spot for Sunday.
Show up and check in, then post your run. Each one earns ten points.
Cheer the crew on with reactions, comments and gifted points.
Then spend your points on a post-run massage.
Find your crew on Well Circle.
